name: Pipeliners - OTTO Outage Check 2026-09-17
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-17

# Summary
Incident record for Sep 17, 2026, when most city pages were served without OTTO SEO data (headings, titles, schema). Two sheet-style HTML reports document the check and the keywords at risk.

# Key findings
- Check at 17:50 to 17:58 UTC: 34 of 37 city pages were served without OTTO (plugin header API_ERROR) to desktop, mobile and both Googlebots. Only /apache-junction/, /casa-grande/ and /fort-mcdowell/ were fine. Four pages (Apache Junction, Coolidge, Litchfield Park, Sacaton) already had the problem in the earlier audit crawl.
- Cause: a full cache flush at 17:42 UTC (done to publish changes C6 to C8) wiped the plugin's stored OTTO copies. Pages re-rendered and hit the OTTO API at once, the API rate-limited the plugin, and LiteSpeed cached pages rendered during backoff without OTTO. Search Atlas was also returning errors.
- Missing while broken: OTTO page schema (Service, OfferCatalog, AggregateRating, service area), og:title, meta keywords, OTTO image alts. Elementor FAQ schema and breadcrumbs stayed.
- MetaSync gives the OTTO API only 2 seconds per page load and 10 calls per minute, and renders without OTTO on a timeout.
- Keywords at risk: 968 of 1,079 keywords sat on an affected page, about 92% of the times the site was shown in Google.

# Decisions and status
- Fixed: all 37 city pages have the right main heading again and all 59 page titles are correct (checked as a visitor).
- SEO data restored page by page, biggest pages first. Pages now keep OTTO data for 24 hours instead of 30 minutes.
- Standing rule: never clear all caches at once on this site again. Residual risk: Googlebot can still catch a page without OTTO if the API is down at crawl time.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `pipeliners-otto-outage-check.html`: per-page check sheet.
- `pipeliners-keywords-at-risk.html`: GSC 28-day keywords on affected pages.
- `page_keywords.csv`, `pages.txt`: keyword and page counts. JSON state checks and Python sweep scripts are not summarized.
